evals.prompt: Write a feature spec for letting users schedule recurring transfers between their own accounts in our banking app.
evals.expected_output: A feature spec with problem and evidence, goals and non-goals, scenarios, numbered testable requirements with Given/When/Then acceptance criteria, states table, non-functional requirements including WCAG 2.2 AA, metrics and open questions.
expectations: Acceptance criteria cover failure cases such as insufficient funds and holidays
Accessibility and security appear as non-functional requirements
Evidence is labeled; no invented user quotes or numbers
